dataList.content:
Thus, we vanquished the bear and claimed the fabled Helm of Mambrino ours!
就此，吾等击败了熊，成功取得了传说中的曼布里诺头盔！

<color=#ffef23>I can obliterate that poor animal in less than three—</color>
<color=#ffef23>只要下定决心……老实说，三秒以内……</color>

<color=#cc2424>Oh, please. Where is the fun in that? We shall battle this fell beast like... ...from the books!</color>
<color=#cc2424>与其让战斗结束得那么干脆，不如像……一样战斗如何？就像书里写的那样。</color>

H-helm...? Do you think these stories are... actual adventures of Don Quixote?
头、头盔……？这些真的是堂吉诃德小姐所经历过的冒险吗？

Miss Don Quixote. Not once have we truly given you chance to regale us with your tales of adventure.
堂吉诃德女士，这似乎是我们第一次听到你的冒险故事啊。

Mhm. She usually only talked about adventures of other Fixers.
她一般都在讲述其他收尾人的冒险故事呢。

Or she would persistently nag us about our own adventures.
或者不厌其烦地打听着我们的冒险。

<... I'm not sure. Let's keep listening.>
<……我不知道。但让我们继续听下去吧。>
